baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَاءُ شَرَعُوا لَهُم مِنَ الدِّينِ مَا لَمْ يَأْذَنْ بِهِ اللَّهُ
baseline_models.mechanism: A coalition sharing claimed authority initiates a binding course of obedience for others, but the construction withholds the license that would connect that course to God.

activation_trace.role: Shared participation supplies the plural authority coalition that claims a portion in norm production.
Entering and taking up an affair makes legislation an initiating act, not passive inheritance.
Obedience and submission identify the human conduct that the initiated norms bind.
License or admission supplies the missing authorization on which the accusation turns.

changed_reading.after: Rival authorities initiated an obedience-regime for beneficiaries while lacking the license that could make them a valid source.

baseline_models.mechanism: The water-source branch of ش ر ع makes the enacted religion an access point into a shared life-regime; partners claim to open and manage that intake without its owner's leave.

activation_trace.role: A visible watering place supplies the intake image and makes norm-giving a management of access.
A shared resource or share supplies the partners who jointly control the intake.
Obedience is the communal life-pattern into which the intake leads.
Permission marks the absent right to open or regulate this access.

changed_reading.after: They installed an unauthorized communal intake into obligation and claimed control over who drinks from its normative source.

baseline_models.mechanism: The counterfactual grammar makes an already operative word prevent immediate judgment; its separating function marks a boundary or interval until adjudication occurs.

activation_trace.role: A meaningful utterance supplies the operative stipulation presupposed by لولا.
Making a boundary visible supplies the word's delimiting function.
Decisive judgment is the event withheld by the operative word.
The interval among parties is the social space maintained until judgment.

changed_reading.before: A final verdict called the word of decision will judge them.
changed_reading.after: A prior delimiting stipulation presently stays judgment and preserves an interval before the parties are decisively sorted.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مِنَ الدِّينِ ... لَقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْ ... الظَّالِمِينَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
baseline_models.mechanism: The enacted dīn can be heard as an imposed liability as well as obedience; final settlement discharges claims, while withholding what is due converts the false regime into painful liability.

activation_trace.role: Reckoning and recompense give the normative order an accounting horizon.
Financial debt supplies the model of obligations placed upon adherents.
Discharging and recovering a right supplies the eventual settlement operation.
Withholding a right identifies the false regime's accountable injury.
Punitive pain is the consequence when the account is settled.
The pain-causing quality makes the liability embodied rather than merely declarative.

changed_reading.after: Unauthorized norm-makers load people with false obligations and withhold rights, creating an account that will be painfully settled.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same شرع ... من الدين construction is first assigned to God and connected through testament and revelation to earlier messengers. Its product is an upright, non-fragmented dīn, so 42:21 attacks rival provenance rather than norm articulation as such.

activation_trace.role: Shared authority marks the rival source whose provenance is under examination.
Divine initiation of the same kind of affair establishes a licensed counterpart to the focus act.
Repeated obedience binds what is instituted to what the community must uphold.
A charge connected onward to another supplies historical continuity rather than private invention.
Divine report and inspiration supply the authorized transmission channel.
Uprightness and balance make establishment the intended community operation.
Scattering into parts supplies the failure that authorized establishment is told to resist.

structural_cues: 42:13 repeats شرع ... من الدين before 42:21 but changes the grammatical source from God to partners.
The sequence in 42:13 joins cross-prophetic transmission, establishment, and the prohibition of fragmentation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated construction and its testament-revelation chain; I infer that authorization is provenance plus continuity, not bare permission. A live alternative is that 42:13 supplies content while 42:21 condemns only its competitors.

changed_reading.before: The focus rejects people making religious law.
changed_reading.after: The focus rejects a rival source-chain: lawgiving is valid when transmitted from God toward upright continuity, and corrupt when partners originate it without that provenance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The near-verbatim counterfactual in 42:14 names a prior word running to a fixed term; this fills the focus construction and turns كلمة الفصل into a temporal stay that precedes the eventual separating judgment.

activation_trace.role: A boundary made visible supplies the delayed word's eventual sorting function.
The repeated meaningful word supplies the explicit antecedent for the focus's operative stipulation.
Precedence places the stipulation before the current dispute and gives it blocking force.
A fixed temporal limit specifies how long immediate adjudication is deferred.
The same decisive judgment remains the counterfactual event prevented for now.
The repeated interval among disputants locates both transgression and postponed judgment in one social field.

structural_cues: 42:14 and 42:21 share ولولا كلمة ... لقضي بينهم with only the description of the word expanded differently.
42:14 explicitly inserts إلى أجل مسمى between the prior word and the unrealized judgment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact syntactic doublet and a fixed term; I infer that 42:21 compresses the prior word into كلمة الفصل and that its present effect is deferment. The materially live alternative is that كلمة الفصل names only the eventual verdict, while an unexpressed decree delays it.

changed_reading.before: The word of separation is simply the final sentence pronounced on the parties.
changed_reading.after: The word is a prior time-bounding stipulation that keeps immediate judgment from occurring until the appointed separation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The harvest immediately before the focus, the earned consequence immediately after it, and later equivalent recompense give the dīn-as-debt baseline a production cycle: norms solicit sowing, acts accrue, and judgment settles the yield.

activation_trace.role: Debt supplies the obligation ledger into which conduct can accrue.
Discharging a right supplies the final settlement of the accrued account.
Work and acquisition make each desired harvest a field of deliberate production.
Acquiring a return makes the wrongdoers' feared consequence their own accrued yield.
Matching an act with its recompense supplies the settlement rule.
Equivalence constrains recompense to the likeness of the originating act.

structural_cues: 42:20 places repeated harvest language immediately before the focus.
42:22 resumes الظالمين and says they fear what they acquired, while 42:40 states an equivalence rule for recompense.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sowing, acquisition, equivalence, and settlement images; I infer a single accrual cycle for imposed obligations and their consequences. A live alternative is that harvest concerns eschatological intention without activating the financial branch of د ي ن.

changed_reading.before: Unauthorized religious rules are later punished.
changed_reading.after: A rival dīn is a liability-producing field: it directs what adherents sow, lets consequences accrue, and comes due under an equivalence-bounded settlement.

context_deltas.mechanism: Words in 42:24 erase falsehood and establish truth, while 42:51 restricts divine-human speech to revelation, a veil, or a messenger who reveals by permission. The focus's missing permission therefore marks a failed transmission credential, not only objectionable content.

activation_trace.role: License supplies the credential absent from the partners' legislative act.
Erasure of an effect gives authenticated words an active falsehood-removing function.
Manifesting and establishing truth supplies the positive effect of God's words.
Meaningful words are the named medium by which falsehood is removed and truth established.
Speech connecting speakers frames the problem as a controlled divine-human communication relation.
Divine report and inspiration supply the content-bearing authenticated channel.
Messenger and message supply the authorized intermediary in the channel.
Permission explicitly licenses the messenger's revelatory relay and resolves the focus's negative clause.

structural_cues: 42:24 links divine words to erasing falsehood and establishing truth.
42:51 closes its list of communication modes with فيوحي بإذنه, echoing the focus's لم يأذن به.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies effective divine words and a permission-governed relay; I infer an authentication protocol whose provenance validates religious norm speech. A live alternative is that إذن remains ordinary permission and does not imply a formal channel model.

changed_reading.before: The partners taught content God had not approved.
changed_reading.after: Their legislation lacks an authenticated chain of speech: unlike revelation relayed by permission, it cannot claim the provenance by which words establish truth.

context_deltas.mechanism: Provision is expanded, constrained to measure, and then rendered as descending rain whose mercy spreads. This ecological sequence activates ش ر ع as a managed water intake: a normative source must distribute life without feeding transgressive excess.

activation_trace.role: A visible watering place supplies the focus's material image of access to a sustaining source.
Spreading and extension supply the opening of provision's flow.
An apportioned gift supplies the resource being distributed rather than privately authored.
Exceeding the limit supplies the social failure produced by unmeasured expansion.
Deliberate calibration supplies the governing restraint on descent and distribution.
Life-giving rain supplies the concrete water that answers despair.
Opening, spreading, and branching supply mercy's distributed reach.

structural_cues: 42:12 and 42:27 pair expansion of provision with restriction or measure.
42:27-28 moves from calibrated descent to rain and spreading mercy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a watering-place branch plus a measured provision-rain sequence; I infer that law can function as social distribution infrastructure. The live alternative is that the water image is only lexical activation and does not describe the intended function of dīn.

changed_reading.after: Partners seize the intake of communal life and install an unlicensed distribution regime, unlike provision that is measured before it descends and spreads.

context_deltas.mechanism: 42:38 gives a legitimate collective architecture: people respond to their Lord, establish an upright practice, and extract judgment reciprocally in affairs among them. This contrasts with the focus's asymmetry, where partners legislate for beneficiaries without permission.

activation_trace.role: Shared participation supplies the possible collective authority whose form must be distinguished from consultation.
Initiating an affair supplies the partners' unilateral norm-producing act.
Answering speech makes the community responsive to its Lord before deliberating its affairs.
Upright balance supplies the established posture in which collective affairs operate.
Consultation and deliberative management identify the domain as their shared affair.
Extracting judgment through reciprocal review supplies the legitimate decision process.
A connective relation among parties makes the process horizontal and reciprocal.

structural_cues: 42:21 says partners legislated for them, whereas 42:38 says their affair is consultation among them.
42:38 places response to the Lord and established prayer before communal deliberation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two different social grammars; I infer that the focus condemns captured or unilateral norm production, not every plural decision process. The live alternative is that consultation governs administration only and has no direct bearing on the source of dīn.

changed_reading.before: Any plural human role in religious ordering looks like condemned partnership.
changed_reading.after: The surah distinguishes accountable reciprocity from captured authorship: communal affairs may be deliberated among responders, but partners may not originate binding dīn for others without authorization.

context_deltas.mechanism: The justice sequence bounds retaliation by equivalence, prefers pardon with repair, and then assigns the prosecutable path to those who wrong people and exceed right. Its exact reprise of painful punishment gives the focus's ظلم a public-rights mechanism.

activation_trace.role: Blocking and withholding a right supplies the concrete injury beneath the focus's wrongdoer label.
Matching an act with recompense supplies a bounded response rather than open-ended punishment.
Leaving punishment and erasing fault supplies a non-retaliatory option.
Removing estrangement between people makes pardon reparative rather than passive.
Withholding rights now explicitly takes people as its objects and identifies the actionable wrong.
Transgressing the limit supplies the expansion of wrongful authority through the land.
A fixed entitlement supplies the boundary that transgression lacks.
Punitive pain repeats the focus's consequence for this socially specified wrongdoing.
Pain-causing severity completes the exact consequence phrase shared with the focus.

structural_cues: 42:42 repeats لهم عذاب أليم from 42:21 while specifying ظلم الناس and transgression without right.
42:40-42 distinguishes equivalent response, pardon with repair, justified self-defense, and actionable oppression.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the exact punishment reprise and an explicit public-rights sequence; I infer that unauthorized religious authority becomes ظلم through effects on people's rights. A live alternative is that 42:42 broadens the class of wrongdoers without defining the narrower wrong in 42:21.

changed_reading.before: The wrongdoers are punished chiefly for holding an unauthorized religious doctrine.
changed_reading.after: Their unauthorized dīn is a public injustice when it withholds rights and exceeds legitimate bounds; the punishment clause belongs to a calibrated justice framework.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates road-groove and hunting-snare branches of ش ر ك rather than ordinary partnership. It remains anchored in شركاء, شرعوا, and الدين and is reinforced by the surah's closing path language. Downstream prose should present it only as a spatial-material metaphor for route capture, never as the lexical replacement of 'partners.'

activation_trace.role: Grooves and main tracks in a road supply a pre-shaped route that channels movement.
A hunter's snare supplies the danger hidden in a route arranged by rival guides.
Opening or directing a line toward a destination supplies the partners' installation of the route.
Obedient movement is what the installed route channels.
An extended traversable path makes legal recourse itself a route with bounded access.
The straight road supplies the authorized destination-bearing alternative.
Straightness and balance qualify the closing path against the partners' captured track.

changed_reading.before: Partners offer a false set of teachings.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they pre-groove the route of obedience and conceal capture within it, opposed by the authorized straight path at the surah's close.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates كلم as a bodily wound and combines it with material splitting. It remains anchored in كلمة الفصل and the focus's painful ending, while context supplies fissure and truth-erasure. Downstream prose should qualify it as an embodied analogy for a decree that exposes and separates, not claim that كلمة literally means a wound here.

activation_trace.role: A bodily wound supplies the material image of a word that leaves an exposing mark.
Cutting apart until a boundary appears makes the word an incision of discrimination.
Pain-causing consequence keeps the material analogy tied to the focus's own embodied close.
Opening and fissuring supply a surah-level image of stress making hidden division visible.
Erasing an effect supplies the word's subtractive action against falsehood.
Establishing and manifesting truth supplies what the incision reveals after removal.

changed_reading.before: The word of separation is an abstract judicial utterance.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it is a deferred verbal incision: it removes false adhesion, exposes the boundary, and leaves the wrongdoer's painful consequence manifest.

strongest_changes: 42:13 makes the focus a contrast between an authorized prophetic source-chain and rival norm authorship, not a rejection of lawgiving itself.
42:14's near-verbatim construction supplies the prior fixed-term word that presently stays the separating judgment.
42:51 turns missing permission into a transmission-provenance failure, while 42:38 distinguishes reciprocal consultation from unilateral legislation for others.
42:42 repeats the painful-punishment clause and exposes the public-rights mechanism of the focus's ظلم.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence joined exact verbal doublets to distal closure: authorization, deferment, accountability, consultation, provision, and path imagery all changed the focus while remaining attached to its own roots and constructions.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether كلمة الفصل itself denotes the prior deferment, the eventual verdict, or a compressed relation between both.
Whether the water-intake and liability-ledger models carry intended mechanisms or remain productive branch analogies.
How far شركاء extends beyond cultic partners to institutional norm-makers without overgeneralizing the focus.
